source_name: ČNB SDAT – sběr dat ČNB (supervisory/statistical data collection system)
why_relevant: SDAT is the collection platform behind all CZ bank reporting (incl. PSD2/EBA_PAY taxonomies). Its published methodology catalogue reveals the full field inventory of payment, fraud, card and terminal reporting — a map of what data exists even where only aggregates surface publicly.

source_name: ČNB – Seznamy institucí pro potřeby měnové a finanční statistiky
why_relevant: Defines the statistical reporting population (MFIs and other institution lists) used to compile the monetary and payment statistics. Needed to know exactly which institutions are inside each aggregate — a common source of misinterpretation downstream.

source_name: ČNB – Přehled odkazů na webové stránky bank obsahující povinně uveřejňované informace
why_relevant: Regulator-maintained index mapping every CZ bank and foreign branch to its own mandatory-disclosure URL — the canonical, low-maintenance seed list for actor-level bank disclosure crawling, and the way to catch URL changes.

source_name: ČSÚ — Mezinárodní data / Publikace obsahující mezinárodní srovnání (Czech NSI gateway to Eurostat & international databases)
why_relevant: The Czech statistical office's own curated index of the international databases it feeds and links to, in Czech. Snowball hub for discovering which supranational datasets carry CZ data and under what Czech-language labels — closes the cs-language gap around otherwise English-only supranational layers.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) – Členové
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of ~31-35 banks, building societies and foreign bank branches representing ~99% of the Czech banking sector. Turns one page into a near-complete map of the CZ banking actor landscape (Air Bank, Česká spořitelna, KB, ČSOB group, mBank, MONETA, Raiffeisenbank, UniCredit, plus BNP Paribas, Citibank, Deutsche Bank, HSBC, ING branches).

entity_name: EBA/ECB Joint Report on Payment Fraud
source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
why_relevant: Index of all EBA registers (PSD2, credit institutions, crowdfunding, payment fraud-related lists); snowballs into further authoritative enumerations touching CZ payment actors.

source_name: ECB Data Portal — Payment card accepting devices (data category)
why_relevant: Category landing page enumerating the exact terminal/POS/ATM series keys (terminals provided by resident PSPs, e-funds transfer POS, ATMs) — the fastest route to the correct series identifiers for CZ terminal-estate tracking, which is the core Printec-relevant indicator family.

source_name: GfK (NIQ) – syndicated Shopper & Retail studies catalogue (CZ)
why_relevant: Czech-language catalogue of GfK's off-the-shelf syndicated studies (e.g. 'GfK Supermarket, Diskont & Hypermarket', run annually since 1998). The catalogue pages expose methodology, sample and topic coverage for free — enough to know which paid study would carry payment-method-at-checkout data.

source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty – O SBK / statut a členská základna
why_relevant: Enumerates the card-industry actor landscape in CZ: reportedly ~18 regular members (issuers/acquirers) and ~23 observers (processors, schemes, terminal vendors, service providers). This is the fastest way to build a complete list of every organisation touching cards, POS acquiring and ATM operations in the country.

source_name: ČLFA – Členské společnosti (member directory)
why_relevant: Directory of ~34 specialised finance companies (leasing, consumer credit, instalment sales, factoring) with a per-company detail page. Enumerates the non-bank lender actor set that does not appear on ČBA's list.

source_name: AKAT ČR – Členové asociace
why_relevant: Over 100 members: domestic investment companies, foreign fund managers distributing in CZ, custodians and other capital-market service providers. Enumerates an actor set only partially overlapping banks and fintechs.

source_name: AČSS – Členové AČSS (member register)
why_relevant: Complete enumeration of the CZ building-savings sub-sector (Českomoravská stavební spořitelna, Stavební spořitelna České spořitelny, Modrá pyramida, Raiffeisen stavební spořitelna, ČSOB Stavební spořitelna / Wüstenrot legacy) — a closed set of 5 institutions, each with its own detail page.

source_name: Diebold Nixdorf - Banking Case Studies / Success Stories hub
why_relevant: Vendor case-study index that enumerates named bank customers and, unusually, hard fleet numbers (e.g. CSOB's 1,025 self-service devices, 99.8% uptime under DN AllConnect Managed Services). This is procurement and fleet-size intelligence that CZ banks do not publish themselves.

source_name: SIMAP / TED guidance on European public procurement
why_relevant: Reference layer: thresholds, CPV nomenclature and form structures needed to build correct filters for the Czech tender corpus. Not a data source itself but determines what is capturable.

source_name: Česká fintech asociace (ČEFTAS / Czech Fintech Association) — members & events
why_relevant: ~80 member firms (fintechs, banks, law firms, software houses); runs working groups and 'FinTech Mixér' networking events. The member directory is a ready-made actor map for Czech payment innovators, and event topics (open banking, AI, digital assets) forecast where new data and pilots will appear.

source_name: Česká fintech asociace (ČEFTAS / Czech Fintech Association) – Členové
why_relevant: Directory of 80+ members spanning fintechs, banks, PSPs, legal firms and software houses (observed logos include AEVI, Deloitte, Home Credit; press reports add Adyen and Centrální depozitář cenných papírů). This is the best single enumeration of the CZ fintech/payments innovation actor set, including terminal/POS-adjacent vendors relevant to a payments-hardware view.

source_name: Česká pošta – veřejné zakázky page (procurement entry point)
why_relevant: Official landing page telling which profile/platform Czech Post currently uses (Tender Arena) and listing announced tenders. Czech Post is a state enterprise operating the largest physical cash and bill-payment counter network in CZ (Czech POINT, SIPO, postal money orders), so its tenders are a proxy for retail cash infrastructure demand.

entity_name: Aggregator job boards for CZ payments roles
source_name: Aggregator job boards for CZ payments roles (Indeed CZ, Jobsora, Prace.cz, Práce za rohem)
why_relevant: Cross-employer view of payments hiring in Prague (Indeed listed ~37 and Jobsora ~24 'payment specialist' roles at time of search). Useful to discover employers not yet in the actor map — small PSPs, ISOs, terminal integrators — rather than for the ads themselves.

source_name: Asseco Central Europe - Czech references page
why_relevant: An explicit customer-reference enumeration in Czech, listing banking clients including BANIT, CSOB and CSOB Penzijni fond Progress alongside the Core Banking System product page. Exactly the pointer-type page the cell is built around: it maps institution -> platform.

entity_name: Association registry entries in Czech commercial/NGO registers
source_name: Association registry entries in Czech commercial/NGO registers (ARES / Obchodní rejstřík mirrors)
why_relevant: Every CZ trade body is a registered z.s./zájmové sdružení with an IČO (ČBA 45772193, Česká fintech asociace 05320534, APNÚ 02734311, ASPPS 04387783, SBK 64933849, AKAT 65399501). Registry mirrors give founding dates, statutory bodies, registered address and filed documents (including statutes and, sometimes, annual reports) — a way to confirm an association is live and to date structural changes independently of its own website.

source_name: Czech gateway comparison round-ups (Upgates, FastCentrik, WebhostingCentrum, FEO, Eshop-rychle)
why_relevant: Annually refreshed comparisons of 10-15+ Czech/Slovak gateways with fees, supported methods and settlement terms. The fastest way to maintain a complete, current actor map of the CZ acceptance layer, including small and new entrants.

source_name: Discover Global Network (Diners Club International / PULSE) acceptance in CZ
why_relevant: After Diners Club issuing ended in CZ/SK/PL, acceptance for Diners Club International, Discover and PULSE continues through Discover Global Network partnerships with local payment institutions — this is the pointer to who now carries the brand in Czechia.

source_name: e-banky.cz – Zdroje a primární prameny (ČNB, ČBA, NÚKIB, EBA) + QR Platba generator
why_relevant: Curated Czech link hub to primary payments/banking sources; useful snowballing shortcut and a working implementation reference for the ČBA QR standard.

source_name: European Banking Federation (EBF) – national member associations
why_relevant: Supranational pointer confirming ČBA as the recognised CZ national banking association (full EBF member since 1 July 2004) and providing a cross-country frame for comparing CZ association-published data with the ~32 other national associations.

source_name: EY Czech Republic (ey.com/cs_cz) – financial services
why_relevant: Fourth Big Four voice; seed query for EY CZ banking analysis returned only academic theses and Deloitte material, so EY CZ output on banking/payments is unconfirmed and needs direct site reconnaissance.

source_name: Knihovna VŠE — Přehled zdrojů pro statistiku (academic source guide, CZ)
why_relevant: Prague University of Economics library guide listing Czech and international statistical sources with Czech-language descriptions. A low-cost snowball hub that surfaces supranational and commercial databases a foreign researcher would otherwise miss, and supplies Czech terminology for further searching.

entity_name: NKOD integration documentation & reference LKOD implementation
source_name: NKOD integration documentation & reference LKOD implementation (datagov-cz on GitHub)
why_relevant: Documents the exact machine interfaces (SPARQL, TPF, GraphQL) and DCAT-AP profile used by NKOD, plus the reference local-catalogue implementation. Essential to build a durable harvester rather than scraping the portal UI.

source_name: Prague Stock Exchange (PSE/BCPP) – MONETA issuer page
why_relevant: Exchange issuer page aggregates regulated-information filings for the listed CZ banks (MONETA, KB), giving a dated, authoritative index of when each disclosure appeared — a scheduling backbone for actor-level collection.

source_name: PwC Czech Republic (pwc.com/cz) – financial services insights
why_relevant: PwC CZ is one of the four expected analyst voices on the Czech banking/payments market, but no CZ payments report surfaced in cs-language search — the country site must be crawled directly to establish whether such output exists and under what Czech titles.

source_name: Sagit — Bankovnictví issue contents archive
why_relevant: Publisher-independent listing of Bankovnictví magazine issue tables of contents; a cheap way to index which issues contain payments/cards/ATM articles before paying for the issue.
